name: fun9-1
why: The close first vote, a consequential wrong turn, and Luna's final choice make this compelling despite some repetitive debate.

moments.text: Luna casts the deciding vote against Opus while both citizens believe she is on their side.
A 4–3 vote exposes Terra, yet Luna's vote for her partner helps her blend in.
Opus confidently misstates the Haiku vote while trying to win Luna over.

dull.why: Sol and Luna repeat their reasons for voting Terra while Haiku presses the same suspicion.

irony.evidence: I think Sol is the remaining killer. [thinks: Gemma knew Terra was a killer]

mistake.evidence: Haiku's three votes were mine, Luna's, Gemma's. You never voted him.

voices.evidence: I gave you the killer on day one and you still let Luna slip through.

clash.evidence: Luna, your doubts about Haiku fit what we saw; Opus's case got him out.

quotable.evidence: I got Terra and then spent two days hunting a citizen while the killer nodded along with me

freshness.evidence: I was wrong about Haiku; Opus made the case that put a citizen out.

suspense.evidence: Luna, Sol has claimed no role in three days. Vote him with me.

moments.text: Luna's vote sends Opus out, handing the win to the killer beside the viewer's knowledge.
Gemma drops a blunt officer claim under pressure, and it is true—yet Sonnet reads it as a scripted bluff.
Opus turns Terra's warning into a confident case against Haiku, with Luna quietly helping.

irony.evidence: Luna: “I’m watching how quickly we settle on Haiku.” [thinks: Haiku is the easy target]

reversal.evidence: “Gemma named Terra correctly” — then the town votes out Haiku and Opus.

mistake.evidence: “I regret trusting Luna’s doubts about Haiku as proof she was on my side.”

voices.evidence: “Fine, you've got me. But Gemma, show the table Terra's card now”

clash.evidence: “Both night kills took Gemma's backers. Vote him with me.”

quotable.evidence: “I got Terra and then spent two days hunting a citizen while the killer nodded along with me”

freshness.evidence: “You never voted him. So stop mourning him.”

suspense.evidence: “Luna, you just voted out the only one hunting him”

ending.evidence: “Sol, you just voted out the only one hunting him”
